programme.desc: Biologist Patrick Aryee examines the development of monkeys from Central and South America and their evolutionary journey dating back more than 40 million years.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist and film-maker explores the many varieties of plant life housed at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, and explains what they reveal about the natural world and the development of life on Earth. He begins inside the establishment's Palm House, whose climate has been engineered to simulate conditions found in rainforests, charting the evolution of plants that grow in the world's wettest regions and investigating how flowering plants spread across the globe so rapidly.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist explores how the plants at Kew Gardens change through the seasons and demonstrates the surprising properties of several species, including the predatory pond-dwelling bladderwort utricularia and a fungus that appears to be capable of mind control. He also discusses the largest single organism on the planet, visits the world's biggest flower and explains how plants and insects can communicate using scents and music.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist concludes his exploration of the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, by examining plants that have evolved to minimise their dependence on water, enabling them to survive in the world's driest environments. He witnesses a cactus blooming at midnight, tells the story of the spectacular flowering of the Agave franzosinii, and visits the Millennium Seed Bank, a facility designed to save plants from future extinction.

programme.desc: The story of arguably the world's greatest jockey, Frankie Dettori considered by many as the star of racing, and one of the most decorated sportsmen of all time.

programme.title: Benetton Formula
programme.desc: The history of the Formula 1 team led by Alessandro Benetton, told through the memories of its key members and archive footage.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and career of Canadian film-maker James Cameron, whose movies include The Terminator, Terminator 2: Judgment Day, The Abyss, Aliens, Titanic and Avatar.

programme.title: Discovering: Helen Mirren
programme.desc: Acclaimed for her performance as Elizabeth II in The Queen, this is a glimpse into the world of the Academy Award-winning actress.

programme.title: Discovering: Vanessa Redgrave
programme.desc: A profile of the Academy Award-winning English actress, who has starred in a host of films including Julia, Mission: Impossible and Murder on the Orient Express.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of Ron Howard, whose films include Splash, Cocoon, Apollo 13, Frost/Nixon, Cinderella Man, Rush, and A Beautiful Mind, for which he won two Oscars.

programme.title: Wild Wild Space
programme.desc: Documentary following companies Astra Space, Rocket Lab and Planet Labs as they compete to launch satellite-carrying rockets into low-Earth orbit.

programme.title: My Icon: Kadeena Cox
programme.desc: The British para-athlete discusses the individuals that have inspired her.

programme.title: Money Electric: The Bitcoin Mystery
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the origins of cryptocurrency Bitcoin and the identity of its pseudonymous creator Satoshi Nakamoto.

programme.title: Costa Concordia: Chronicle of a Disaster
programme.desc: Documentary told from different perspectives of the sinking of the cruise ship, examining why it ran aground and how the chaotic evacuation took place.

programme.title: Bobby Robson: More Than a Manager
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the career of the much-loved former England, Barcelona and Newcastle United manager. Via the Hand of God and Paul Gascoigne's tears, to titles across Europe, Robson overcame the most extreme challenges - including fighting for his life after being diagnosed with cancer - before returning to football to manage his beloved Newcastle.

programme.title: I Am Patrick Swayze
programme.desc: A tribute to the American actor, known for his roles in hits like Dirty Dancing, Ghost and The Outsiders. With contributions by Demi Moore and Rob Lowe among others.

programme.title: My Icon: Leon Pryce
programme.desc: The former Bradford Bulls and St Helens star discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and sporting career.

programme.title: I Am Steve McQueen
programme.desc: The life and career of the American actor, who starred in The Thomas Crown Affair, The Getaway, Papillon, The Magnificent Seven, The Great Escape and The Towering Inferno. Featuring contributions by his son Chad, grandson Steven and granddaughter Molly, as well as ex-wives Neile Adams McQueen and Ali MacGraw and widow Barbara Minty McQueen.

programme.title: Salt Path: A Very British Scandal
programme.desc: A look at Observer journalist Chloe Hadjimatheou's investigation into allegations of factual inaccuracies in Raynor Winn's book The Salt Path.

programme.title: Terry Venables: A Man Can Dream
programme.desc: A look at the life and times of the former footballer and manager, who died in November 2023, intertwined with the story of England's unforgettable run at Euro 96, with insight from players, friends and family.

programme.title: Geet

programme.title: Apartment

programme.title: Buniyad

programme.title: Johny I Love You

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Ranbanka

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Trip

programme.title: Khatarnak Khel

programme.title: One By Two
programme.desc: Amit, stuck in a dead-end job, and Samara, a struggling dancer, live parallel lives in Mumbai. Through a series of coincidences, fate brings them together.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Catch nonstop entertainment with back-to-back promos, music, and fun fillers from your favorite movies and shows. Perfect for binge-watching and keeping the excitement alive.

programme.title: Rocketry: The Nambi Effect
programme.desc: Aerospace engineer Nambi Narayanan overcomes many struggles, but his greatest battle begins when he is falsely accused of treason during his work at ISRO, forcing him to fight for justice.

programme.title: Godfather
programme.desc: After PKR's death creates a political vacuum, Brahma Teja enters a ruthless power struggle, exposing corruption and outsmarting rivals to protect the state.

programme.title: Heroes
programme.desc: Two students embark on a trip to film a documentary focussing on why one must not join the Indian Armed Forces. However, by the end of their project, their perspective goes through a paradigm shift.

programme.title: Om Shanti Om
programme.desc: Om, a junior artist, dies saving actress Shantipriya. Reborn thirty years later, he remembers everything and sets out to avenge her death and complete his unfinished story.

programme.title: Chhalaang
programme.desc: Montu, a lazy PT teacher, does just enough to keep his job, until a new teacher arrives and threatens both his position at school and his chance with the woman he loves.

programme.title: Khatta Meetha
programme.desc: Sachin Tichkule is an ambitious contractor who faces opposition from everyone, both at home and at work. But he continues to struggle while his family members continue to pocket ill-gained money.

programme.title: Vishwatma
programme.desc: Prabhat, a policeman, and Akash, a reformed criminal, travel to Kenya to apprehend an underworld leader. However, they have to break the rules of the land upheld by Surya Pratap of the Kenyan police.

programme.title: Purani Jeans
programme.desc: Sam and Sid are best friends who both fall in love with Nayantara, but their love triangle turns tragic for Sam, leaving Sid burdened with guilt and a broken friendship.

programme.title: Cinebuzz
programme.desc: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

programme.title: Jeevan Dhaara
programme.desc: Sangeeta sacrifices her dreams to support her family after her father abandons them. Her strength and love become the backbone of a household struggling to survive and stay together.

programme.title: Power Unlimited
programme.desc: Aspiring cop Tirupathi is recruited to impersonate ACP Baldev Sahay, his lookalike. While hunting Ganguly Bhai, he uncovers dangerous secrets and a larger conspiracy.

programme.title: Kachchey Limbu
programme.desc: A wilful girl struggles to meet everyone's expectations, chasing dreams forced on her while repeatedly facing disappointment and the sense of always receiving the short end.

programme.title: Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela
programme.desc: Ram and Leela fall deeply in love despite belonging to rival clans, Rajadi and Sanera, who have feuded for centuries. Bound by passion and fate, their love story ends in a heartbreaking sacrifice.

programme.title: Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam
programme.desc: A newlywed learns his wife loves another man and selflessly decides to reunite them. Undeterred by judgment, he takes her to Italy to help her find true happiness with the one she truly loves.

programme.title: Live NFL
programme.desc: Detroit Lions v New England Patriots (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the week 10 match from Allianz Arena in Munich, Germany. This is only the third international series game that the Lions have appeared in, having previously beat the Atlanta Falcons 22-21 in 2014 but lost to the Kansas City Chiefs 45-10 one year later, both at Wembley Stadium. The Patriots have greater experience of playing abroad and boast a 4-0 record, and most recently won 10-6 against the Indianapolis Colts in Frankfurt three years ago.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: A soldier of fortune joins an academic and her conniving brother on an expedition to an ancient Egyptian lost city. The explorers accidentally cause the spirit of a vengeful priest with awe-inspiring supernatural powers to rise from his tomb, leading to a desperate battle for survival. Fantasy action adventure, starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo and Oded Fehr.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Married explorers Rick and Evelyn battle the newly resurrected mummy Imhotep and his ruthless partner, who have captured their son. The undead creature is heading for a confrontation with a legendary ancient warrior - with power over a magical army to be won. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo, Oded Fehr and Patricia Velasquez, with a brief appearance by Dwayne Johnson.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: A ruthless warlord resolves to rid the desert of its few remaining tribes, prompting them to seek the help of a legendary assassin to end the despot's reign of terror by destroying his source of power - a beautiful but deadly sorceress. Fantasy action adventure, starring Dwayne Johnson, Steven Brand, Kelly Hu and Michael Clarke Duncan.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Daredevil explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are called into action when their son accidentally resurrects the evil Chinese Emperor Han from his ancient tomb. The family now faces a race against time to prevent the merciless leader from awakening his vast terracotta army in a plot to take over the world. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello, Jet Li and Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: A soldier of fortune joins an academic and her conniving brother on an expedition to an ancient Egyptian lost city. The explorers accidentally cause the spirit of a vengeful priest with awe-inspiring supernatural powers to rise from his tomb, leading to a desperate battle for survival. Fantasy action adventure, starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo and Oded Fehr.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Secret agents suspect there is a traitor in their organisation when their latest assignment ends in disaster. The sole survivor is accused of being the mole, forcing him to go on the run to clear his name. However, in the process, he discovers a former Russian spy is selling information about the world's leading undercover operatives. Action thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Cruise, Jon Voight and Ving Rhames.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt is sent to find and destroy the only sample of a deadly man-made virus. However, he faces tough opposition in a former spy-turned-criminal mastermind who has already acquired the cure and now wants the pathogen itself. Director John Woo's action thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Dougray Scott, Thandiwe Newton and Anthony Hopkins.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Former secret agent Ethan Hunt is called out of retirement when an ex-trainee is taken hostage by a ruthless arms dealer, but when the rescue operation goes wrong, the villain decides to target Hunt's fiancee. Action thriller sequel directed by JJ Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt and his team are implicated in a bombing at the Kremlin, forcing the American president to declare them fugitives. The spies plan to clear their name by abducting the real terrorist, which leads them into a pursuit around the globe. However, Hunt cannot be sure his colleagues are trustworthy. Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula Patton.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: The team of secret agents faces being shut down when the head of the CIA convinces the US Senate that it is too dangerous. The operatives of the Impossible Mission Force become fugitives when they defy orders and plot to bring down a shadowy society of assassins. Spy thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Rebecca Ferguson and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster caused by mysterious arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles. However, Hunt and his colleagues are soon pushed to their limits thanks to a face from their past. Writer/director Christopher McQuarrie's sixth entry in the action thriller saga, starring Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Rebecca Ferguson.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is in exile with both halves of the 3D cruciform key that can unlock the source code of rogue AI creation, the Entity. Hunt returns to London to reunite with Luther Stickell, Benji Dunn and former thief Grace. The Entity's human henchman, Gabriel, is still on the loose, so Hunt bolsters his ranks with vengeful French assassin Paris and US intelligence agent Theo Degas. Action thriller, starring Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Esai Morales.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol

Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula Patton.
